o.text: A calque of Turkish keşfet, with the original Turkish spelling preserved. The structure and usage as a noun are contrary to the grammar of Azerbaijani.
Borrowed from Russian метеорология (meteorologija). from German Meteorologie. By surface analysis, meteoro- + -logiya.
